source.redistributionDecision: Allowed. Every committed deck is under examples/ or tests/, which upstream COPYING places under Modified BSD; decks with a third-party notice are excluded and not committed.
source.mechanicalAdaptation: None. Every fixture is byte-identical to the pinned revision (SHA-256 pinned per file).
